title: Four-star general from the Clinton administration got inside the program

tellings.quote: I also know a four-star general from the Clinton administration who was able to go there, use his authority, his power uh to go see the program and get inside,

plain: In the 1990s, a four-star general in President Bill Clinton's administration is said to have used his rank and authority to visit a secret program holding recovered crashed craft, and to have gotten inside. The physicist Eric W. Davis says he knows this general personally and relays what he was told. If true, it would mean that even top officials have to force their way in to see such a program.
